entries.actionText: Run Qualys SSL Server Test on all public endpoints (enable 'Do not show on boards'). Disable TLS 1.0/1.1 and enforce TLS 1.2+. Maintain an inventory of trusted keys and certificates in Azure Key Vault or equivalent with access controls.

Deploy and verify anti-malware or EDR on every in-scope system component. Enable real-time/on-access scanning, automatic quarantine, and daily signature updates. Provide console screenshots for all sampled hosts.

Engage a reputable independent firm for annual authenticated and unauthenticated web application and infrastructure penetration tests covering the full external footprint. Remediate critical/high findings within one month and obtain retest evidence.

Publish a permission matrix mapping each Microsoft Graph permission to endpoints, methods, and business features. Remove excess Application permissions, document credential custody (Key Vault/certificate), and validate least privilege in Entra app registration screenshots.

Document AI integration architecture. For Copilot agents, list agents and automated tasks per Microsoft guidance. For custom engine agents, complete the Microsoft RAI Impact Assessment and attach review evidence.
Maintain a documented incident response plan covering roles, escalation, Microsoft notification requirements, and tabletop test records at least annually.
